definitions: After an unpleasant experience, one is careful to avoid similar situations.
A person who has been hurt by something will be extra careful to avoid that thing in the future.
examples: I tried online dating once and it was a disaster; once bitten twice shy, I'm not doing that again.
She lost a lot of money in that investment, so now she's once bitten twice shy about putting her savings into the stock market.
synonyms: a scalded cat fears hot water
